_comment: v8: v7's retreat term (pay only for being un-shootable with an armed enemy inside retreat_contact_dist, plus a leash on wandering past retreat_leash_radius from gas.pos) kept exactly as it was -- it removed the map-edge behaviour and produced 58-69% line-broken. What v8 changes is INTENT_SCALE, in rewards.py: under retreat a kill now costs (-1.0) and damage taken counts double. v7 zeroed the kill and the intents still collapsed into one behaviour, because killing remained the surest way to stop taking damage. The point of the pair is that the SLM's choice has to change what the controller does, or the hierarchy buys nothing. Every key is spelled out: --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults.
